title: Pager temporary page workspace

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerTempSpace exposes the stable page-sized temporary workspace owned by a Pager for rollback and cooperating modules.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager owns and retires the workspace with page-size changes and destruction
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete workspace accessor and its Pager allocation/deallocation lifetime are assigned in the production Pager owner.

contracts.ownership: Pager retains ownership; callers borrow until page-size change or Pager destruction.
contracts.state_and_results: First access lazily allocates page_size bytes; repeated access returns the same storage. Page-size change retires old storage.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager synchronization. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Lazy allocation may return NoMemory without publishing partial storage.

representation_differences: The source allocates pTmpSpace during Pager creation/page-size setup and the accessor is infallible. Zig lazily allocates on first bounded access and therefore returns NoMemory; once allocated, pointer stability and page-sized ownership match.

oracle.protocol: Access twice at page size 4096, compare length and pointer identity, then change page size and observe old workspace retirement before reallocation.
oracle.normalization: Allocation timing is normalized; successful workspace bytes and lifetime boundaries compare exactly.

assurance.oom: Lazy allocation maps allocator failure to NoMemory without state publication; deterministic injection remains pending.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns Pager synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: page_size is a validated nonzero Pager invariant.
assurance.continuation: Allocation failure is retryable; successful repeated access is stable.
assurance.performance: One allocation per page-size lifetime and constant-time subsequent access.

integration.native_call_path: Pager deinit and setPageSize retire the same optional storage returned by temporarySpace; rollback/header owners may borrow it.

independent_review.notes: Requires OOM/resize trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add deterministic first-access OOM and resize/reallocation trace against pinned C ownership.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/pager.c Pager pTmpSpace field, allocation/reallocation/free sites, and lines 3868-3885 were reviewed
src/core/internal/pager_core.zig Pager lifetime, setPageSize, rollback owners, and tests were reviewed
assertions_branches_cleanup: The generated return block is assigned
No partial storage is published on OOM
Page-size changes and Pager destruction free the owned storage
upstream_tests: Upstream pager rollback, page-size, backup, OOM, and crash tests exercise the workspace
Project pager core/differential suites exercise rollback and page-size state
